data.long_meaning: The name Balai is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'strength' or 'power'. This name is associated with the god Vishnu, who embodies strength, protection, and preservation. The name Balai carries the meaning “Strength, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balai usually hope their child will grow to embody strength, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
